title: Completing a maintenance task
description: Mark a task done and let the planner reschedule it.

steps.text: Open Smart Planner and find the task.
Open the task and tap Mark Completed.
AftLog records the date and reschedules the next one.

tips: Completing tasks on time protects your Boat Health Score.
Intervals roll forward from the completion date.
affects: Boat Health Score, reminders, and seasonal readiness.
examples: Marking lower unit oil done after servicing.
Tapping complete right after a DIY job.
